name: Frontier Home Medical Inc
old_description: Come to us for respiratory support and medical devices for complex pulmonary and sleep care.
about:
Frontier Home Medical began in 1998 in Cozad, Nebraska, as a family-owned provider of medical equipment services to nearby communities. The company has since expanded to seven locations across the state and is now headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, remaining under family ownership.

The company supplies a range of durable medical equipment and related services, including respiratory therapy devices such as oxygen concentrators, CPAP/BiPAP machines, and nebulizers; mobility equipment from canes to power wheelchairs; home safety products like ramps, stair glides, and hospital beds; incontinence supplies; nutritional supplements; diabetic footwear; and pediatric medical equipment. Frontier operates through its seven retail locations and works directly with healthcare providers to fit and deliver equipment to patients.

Frontier serves patients, physicians, and healthcare providers throughout Nebraska and western Iowa. Its customer base includes individuals with complex pulmonary and sleep conditions, mobility impairments, incontinence needs, and nutritional deficiencies, as well as infants and children requiring specialized equipment.

The company emphasizes its family-owned structure and a mission centered on patient experience, stating that its focus is on comprehensive patient support and making home-based care as convenient as possible.
